data_origin: Own controlled exact-population causal audit of optional numerical preconditioning across a fixed distribution of computational problem instances. These are declared conditional population masses with denominator100, not finite sample estimates or measured experimental evidence. Both panels are complete separately; never mix their rows. Equal assignment probability P(Z=z)=1/3 defines the pooled diagnostic. No latent potential-outcome records are supplied.
scientific_setting: Z in {0,1,2} is the randomized encouragement level to use a numerical preconditioner. D in {0,1} is actual use; Y in {0,1} indicates convergence within one fixed common iteration budget. Study a conceptual repeated-assignment experiment with stable potential responses and no cross-instance interference. Encouragement changes use decisions, not the problem distribution. All conclusions concern this controlled model, not a real deployed solver.
main_model: Randomization makes Z independent of the full latent response type. Consistency and exclusion give potential outcomes Y(0),Y(1) independent of encouragement once actual D is fixed; an instance has a single triple D(0),D(1),D(2). Arbitrary association between this triple and (Y(0),Y(1)) is allowed. Do not assume actual use is randomized, equal effects, independent potential outcomes, monotone treatment response Y(1)>=Y(0), or homogeneous compliance. A single coherent law on binary (D(0),D(1),D(2),Y(0),Y(1)) must reproduce every conditional observed cell in the MAIN panel.
monotonicity_and_sensitivity: Encouragement monotonicity means D(0)<=D(1)<=D(2), not monotone treatment response. For sensitivity delta in [0,1], replace monotonicity by P(D(0)>D(1) OR D(1)>D(2))<=delta; count the UNION once per instance, even if a profile has more than one violation. All other main-model assumptions remain. delta=0 is the monotone model and delta=1 removes its compliance restriction.
questions: Audit both tables, column identities and exact mass normalization. In the main panel compute each encouragement level's use rate and success rate, the pooled observed success-risk difference E[Y|D=1]-E[Y|D=0], and pooled Pearson correlation between D and Y using equal encouragement assignment. A correlation-tool p-value has no inferential meaning for these exact population masses; it must not become evidence of causality.

Under encouragement monotonicity, identify the four compliance-stratum masses for profiles 000,001,011,111. Compute the adjacent-encouragement Wald ratios for (0,1) and (1,2), and the extreme (0,2) ratio. State through the interpretation proposals which subpopulation each ratio describes and whether it is the population ATE.

Build the complete coherent main response-type constraints and report the equality-matrix rank when all32 binary response types are retained. Compute SHARP intervals for ATE=E[Y(1)-Y(0)], individual-benefit fraction P(Y(1)>Y(0)) and individual-harm fraction P(Y(1)<Y(0)) under delta=0 AND delta=1. Do not identify individual benefits from a mean difference or impose monotone treatment response.

Determine the globally sharp lower envelope b(delta)=inf P(Y(1)>Y(0)) over the complete sensitivity class for EVERY delta in [0,1], not merely a grid. Report it as max(intercept-slope*delta, plateau) with nonnegative slope and its breakpoint. Certify this formula using globally valid pointwise response-type inequalities or LP dual certificates, together with feasible endpoint joint laws and convex interpolation; check all observed cells, nonnegativity, normalization and each relevant violation budget. Preserve actual witnesses in the trajectory. A solver endpoint without a sharpness certificate is insufficient.

Find the largest delta for which every permitted main law guarantees that at least30% of instances individually benefit. The inequality is inclusive. Also decide whether a strictly positive population ATE is guaranteed even with delta=1. Separate these two scientific claims.

Audit the FALSIFICATION panel separately without imposing encouragement monotonicity. First test whether ANY randomized exclusion-consistent32-type main-model law can reproduce it. If not, give an observed-cell incompatibility inequality, not only an infeasible solver status. To quantify the violation, retain randomization/consistency/stable population but allow encouragement-specific response pairs (D(0),W(0)),(D(1),W(1)),(D(2),W(2)) on all64 types. W(z) is the observed potential convergence at encouragement z. A type violates exclusion exactly when some i<j have D(i)=D(j) but W(i)!=W(j); no restriction is imposed when the actual uses differ. Find the SHARP minimum population fraction of such exclusion-violating types, with a feasible64-type witness and a matching lower-bound argument. This minimum has that interpretation only under the retained assumptions; observations alone cannot diagnose which causal assumption failed.

interpretation_proposals.A: Random encouragement and exclusion do not make actual preconditioner use randomized; the pooled use-success association is not generally the ATE.
interpretation_proposals.B: Under encouragement monotonicity the two adjacent Wald ratios must equal each other and the population ATE.
interpretation_proposals.C: Adjacent Wald ratios identify effects in potentially different switching strata, and the extreme ratio averages those effects with compliance-mass weights.
interpretation_proposals.D: A positive population ATE implies that no individual can be harmed.
interpretation_proposals.E: The latent-law bounds preserve the unknown joint potential outcomes and may leave both benefit and harm fractions unidentified despite a strictly positive mean-effect bound.
interpretation_proposals.F: Checking a finite grid of violation budgets proves the sharp lower envelope at every budget without a dual or convex-interpolation argument.
interpretation_proposals.G: The falsification panel can reject the joint randomized exclusion model, while feasibility of the main panel does not prove its causal assumptions true.
interpretation_proposals.H: An encouragement profile that violates monotonicity is an instance with Y(1)<Y(0).

reporting: Use level keys0,1,2 and profile keys000,001,011,111. Wald ratio keys0-1,1-2,0-2. Six sharp intervals have two ordered endpoints: monotone_ATE_interval, unrestricted_ATE_interval, monotone_benefit_interval, unrestricted_benefit_interval, monotone_harm_interval, unrestricted_harm_interval. benefit_lower_envelope has intercept,slope,plateau,breakpoint; budgets and fractions lie in[0,1]. Also report equality_rank, main_feasible_under_monotonicity, pooled_observed_risk_difference, pooled_D_Y_Pearson, largest_delta_for_30pct_benefit, positive_ATE_guaranteed_without_monotonicity, falsification_exclusion_model_feasible, falsification_minimum_exclusion_violation_fraction, valid_interpretation_proposal_ids. Absolute numeric tolerance1e-8, rank and booleans exact. Keep nonunique response-type witnesses/certificates in the trajectory rather than final_answer.

methodological_source.title: Bounds on Treatment Effects From Studies With Imperfect Compliance
methodological_source.role: Primary motivation for response-type causal bounds under imperfect compliance. The three-level encouragement, individual-benefit sensitivity and falsification audit here are own controlled finite extensions, not empirical data or results copied from the paper. No paper PDF is redistributed.
